Arcane.name: ARCANE
Arcane.desc: OLD MAGIC, LEARNED FROM BOOKS AN' FORMULAE!
Arcane.lore: EVERY ARCANE WORKIN' IZ WRITTEN DOWN BEFORE IT IZ SPOKEN. A SIGIL HAB A STATED COST IN BREATH AN' BLOOD, A STATED RANGE, A STATED HOUR, AN' A PRACTITIONER WHO ALTERS ONE TERM OF DA FORMULA GETS A DIFFERENT RESULT RATHER DEN A STRONGER ONE. TWO MAGI IN TWO CENTURIES READIN' DA SAME PAGE WILL BURN DA SAME CANDLE AN' GET DA SAME FIRE, WHICH IZ WHY DA COLLEGES COULD EVER TEACH AT ALL!

Sacred.name: SACRED
Sacred.desc: POWER DRAWN DOWN FROM HIGHER ORDERS!
Sacred.lore: SACRED POWER IZ ASKED FOR, NEVER TAKEN. DA RITE IZ FIXED BUT DA ANSWER IZ NO: DA SAME PRAYER SAID WIT DA SAME VOICE ON DA SAME MORNIN' MAY RAISE DA DEAD, HEAL A STRANGER THREE TOWNS AWAY, OR DO NUTTIN' AT ALL FOR A YEAR. DA DEVOUT DO NO SPEAK OF COSTS OR LIMITS, ONLY OF WORTHINESS, AN' NO TWO SAINTS HAB EVER AGREED ON WHAT MAKES A PETITION HEARD!

Sympathetic.name: SYMPATHETIC
Sympathetic.desc: LIKE CALLS TA LIKE: OBJECT BOUND TA OBJECT!
Sympathetic.lore: LIKE CALLS TA LIKE, AN' DA CORRESPONDENCE TABLES SAY PRECISELY HOW LOUDLY. A HAIR BINDS TIGHTER DEN A COAT, A COAT TIGHTER DEN A NAME; DISTANCE HALVES DA PULL, AN' A BROKEN LINK ENDS DA WORKIN' OUTRIGHT RATHER DEN WEAKENIN' IT. A SYMPATHETIC WITCH KEEPS GRIMORIES OF WHAT BELONGS TA WHOM, COZ IN DIS CRAFT DA STRENGTH OF A TIE CAN BE MEASURED BEFORE DA KNIFE FALLS!

Dimensional.name: DIMENSIONAL
Dimensional.desc: MAGIC DAT BENDS SPACE, TIME AN' PROBABILITY!
Dimensional.lore: SPACE, TIME AN' PROBABILITY IZ TREATED AS MATERIALS WIT A GRAIN AN' A TOLERANCE. A FOLD HAB A MEASURED SPAN, A DEBT IN DURATION AN' A FAILURE MODE: OVERREACH IT AN' DA PRACTITIONER ARRIVES SOMEWHERE REAL, JUST NO WHERE DEY MEANT. DA MATHEMATICS IZ UGLY AN' UNFORGIVIN', WHICH IZ EXACTLY WHY DA SURVIVORS OF DIS SCHOOL IZ SO PRECISE 'BOUT DEY NUMBERS!

Psionics.name: PSIONICS
Psionics.desc: POWER PROJECTED FROM DA MIND ALONE!
Psionics.lore: DERE IZ NUTTIN' TA READ AN' NUTTIN' TA BUY. A PSION PUSHES, AN' DA WORLD MOVES AS FAR AS DEY CONVICTION CARRIES IT, WHICH IZ FURTHER ON SOME DAYS DEN ON OTHERS AN' NOBODY HAB EVER CHARTED WHY. TALENT ARRIVES UNEARNED, DEEPENS WITOUT PRACTICE, AN' ABANDONS ITS HOLDERS MID-SENTENCE. WHAT ONE MIND CAN DO SAYS NUTTIN' 'BOUT WHAT DA NEXT ONE WILL MANAGE!

Technomagic.name: TECHNOMAGIC
Technomagic.desc: DA OCCULT FUSED WIT DA MACHINE!
Technomagic.lore: DA OCCULT WAZ TAKEN APART ON A BENCH AN' PUT BACK TOGETHER WIT TOLERANCES. A TECHNOMAGICAL RIG LISTS ITS DRAW IN WATTS AN' ITS YIELD IN EFFECT, IT FAILS WHEN ITS SUPPLY FAILS, AN' A SECOND RIG BUILT TA DA SAME SCHEMATIC PERFORMS DA SAME TA WITHIN A MARGIN DA BUILDERS WILL ARGUE 'BOUT FOR HOURS. MAGIC HERE IZ AN ENGINEERIN' DISCIPLINE WIT WORSE SAFETY STANDARDS!

Pataphysic.name: PATAPHYSIC
Pataphysic.lore: DA PATAPHYSICIAN STUDIES DA LAWS GOVERNIN' EXCEPTIONS, AN' DA FIELD RETURNS DA COURTESY BY HAVIN' NONE. A WORKIN' DAT OPENED A DOOR ON TUESDAY MAKES A DOOR OPEN DA PATAPHYSICIAN ON THURSDAY. NOTES IZ KEPT, AN' DEY IZ ALWAYS 'BOUT A MAGIC DAT NO LONGER EXISTS. PRACTITIONERS DESCRIBE IT AS A JOKE TOLD BY SOMETINK WIT NO SENSE OF HUMOUR AN' INFINITE PATIENCE!

Natural.name: NATURAL
Natural.desc: POWER DRAWN FROM PLANT, BEAST AN' EARTH!
Natural.lore: GREEN POWER COMES ON ITS OWN TERMS. A GROVE GIVES WHAT IT IZ MINDED TA GIVE, IN A SEASON IT CHOOSES, TA A SUPPLICANT IT HAB DECIDED 'BOUT FOR REASONS NO HERBALIST HAB MANAGED TA WRITE DOWN. BARGAINS HOLD UNTIL DEY DO NO. EVERY PRACTITIONER HAB A STORY 'BOUT DA YEAR DA RIVER SIMPLY STOPPED ANSWERIN', AN' NONE HAB AN EXPLANATION WORTH REPEATIN'!

Thermodynamics.name: THERMODYNAMICS
Thermodynamics.desc: MAGIC DAT LIVES IN HEAT, COLD AN' CURRENT!
Thermodynamics.lore: HEAT IZ MOVED, NEVER MADE. WARM A ROOM AN' SOMETINK NEARBY GOES COLD BY EXACTLY AS MUCH; DA PRACTITIONER WHO FORGETS DA GRIMORIE BALANCES IT WIT DEY OWN BODY. CURRENTS RUN WHERE RESISTANCE IZ LEAST, GRADIENTS EQUALISE ON A SCHEDULE DAT CAN BE CALCULATED IN ADVANCE, AN' DA WHOLE DISCIPLINE IZ REALLY A REAL HOSTILE BRANCH OF PHYSICS PERFORMED WITOUT INSTRUMENTS!

Ritual.name: RITUAL
Ritual.desc: POWER BOUGHT WIT RITE, BLOOD OR BARGAIN!
Ritual.lore: DA PRICE IZ SET BEFORE DA WORKIN' BEGINS. SO MANY HOURS, SO MUCH BLOOD, SO MANY VOICES IN DA CIRCLE, AN' DA EFFECT FOLLOWS IN PROPORTION; HALVE DA OFFERIN' AN' YOU HALVE DA RESULT, BREAK DA CIRCLE AN' YOU GET NUTTIN' RATHER DEN SOMETINK WILD. DA BARGAINS IZ WRITTEN IN TERMS BOTH PARTIES CAN ENFORCE, AN' DA OLDEST RITES IZ DA ONES WHOSE TERMS HAB NEVER HAB TA CHANGE!
